notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Jefferson County Fair in Rigby, 208-745-6685, Ruth, with CALL TUES MORNING, SEND EMAIL, and CALL AFTER NEW YEAR FOR 2027. Current Jefferson County information confirms the Rigby Fair Aug. 10-15, 2026. Preserve the 2027 instruction without inventing a due date. Source: handwritten call notes, page 83; Adventure Zone Gmail/current county website.
